notes: Reconstructed by tools/tubuild.py create and then reconciled by hand. No pragma is needed anywhere in this unit: both functions reproduced byte-exact on the first compile under the build's stock flags, with codegen left deferred, so the whole file is written in the reverse of ROM address order and mwccarm's end-of-file emission puts the two .text sections back in ROM-ascending order.

tubuild create reported no cross-file conflicts in includes, externs, macros or local declarations, and no destructor variants or pragmas in either legacy source. The only reconciliation was cosmetic: the Behavior shard routed both of its tests through a redundant `int v` temporary copied out of unk_00c, which the merged source drops in favour of testing the member directly. Both functions were re-verified byte-exact afterwards.

The one extern this TU carries, data_0208ee44, is spelt `extern int` -- the plurality spelling in the tree and the one its other scalar users (src/actors/dScMgCup_c.cpp, src/minigames/d_s_mg_base.cpp) already use. config/decl-agreement-baseline.json banks five pre-existing disagreements on this symbol (`unsigned char []`, `char`, `int []`); this TU does not add to them and none were touched.

This class's constructor and destructor are inline in include/dThIcon_c.h and are not odr-used here, so unlike the sibling dCapIcon_c TU in this overlay no C1/C2/D0/D1/D2 variant is emitted at all. The only compiler-only output is the vague-linkage RTTI trio below, and all three have ROM homes, so this TU has no homeless symbol to deadstrip.
